import pandas as pd

# Create the dataframe from the provided table
data = {
    'round': [3, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 8, 8, 9, 9],
    'player': ['rob bellamy', 'r j anderson', 'david laliberte', 'chris zarb', 'gino pisellini', 'ladislav scurko', 'frederik cabana', 'martin houle', 'travis gawryletz', 'triston grant', 'john carter'],
    'position': ['right wing', 'defense', 'right wing', 'defense', 'right wing', 'center', 'center', 'goaltender', 'defense', 'left wing', 'center'],
    'nationality': ['united states', 'united states', 'canada', 'united states', 'united states', 'slovakia', 'canada', 'canada', 'canada', 'canada', 'united states'],
    'college / junior / club team (league)': ['new england jr coyotes ( ejhl )', 'centennial high school (minn)', 'prince edward island rocket ( qmjhl )', 'tri - city storm ( ushl )', 'plymouth whalers ( ohl )', 'spišská nová ves (slovakia)', 'halifax mooseheads (qmjhl)', 'cape breton screaming eagles (qmjhl)', 'trail smoke eaters ( bchl )', 'vancouver giants ( whl )', 'brewster bulldogs (emjhl)']
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Filter rounds between 3 and 9 inclusive
df_filtered = df[(df['round'] >= 3) & (df['round'] <= 9)]

# Count players per round
players_per_round = df_filtered['round'].value_counts().sort_index()

# Check if each round between 3 and 9 has exactly 2 players
rounds_range = list(range(3, 10))  # rounds 3 to 9 inclusive
all_rounds_have_two = all(players_per_round.get(round_num, 0) == 2 for round_num in rounds_range)

# Check total number of players in these rounds is 11
total_players = df_filtered.shape[0]
total_is_eleven = total_players == 11

# The statement is true only if both conditions hold
answer = all_rounds_have_two and total_is_eleven
